title: 6.7 Turn left at the bakery
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
goal: Give a direction with a place to turn at (Turn left at the bakery. Turn right at the police station.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.7 Which Side of the Street?: A1 finds a place on the left or on the right; A1+ 6.7 turns at a place. The new grammar relationship is at + a landmark after A1 6.8's turn left / turn right (Turn left at the bakery.), with 6.1's new places as landmarks and A1 6.10's How do I get to …?. Every photo is seen from behind one walker at a crossroads who points one whole arm along the side street that goes past the named place, which stands on that corner; the other corner is a plain office building.
prerequisite: A1 6.7 left and right; A1 6.8 turn left/right, go straight; A1 6.10 How do I get to…?; A1+ 6.1 places.
speaking_outcome: Link turn left at (turn-LEFT-at). Do not require native-like speed.
